# has skill

Relates an agent to a skill it possesses. Non-functional — an agent may have many skills. The leveled, scaled detail is carried by the reified gmeow:SkillProficiency.

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasSkill>  
**CURIE:** `gmeow:hasSkill`
